additional_info.subject: RE: ID0437623-DC/Si-D/UA-[MP / R9 170002580]secc is out of order CRM:00921001738
additional_info.body:
Dear eMobility Tech Support Team,
I kindly ask you to clarify why the ticket was closed?
This ticket was not related to the fan GQ2-3 issue.
This ticket was related to problem with AC port after updating the charger from version 4.1.3 to version 7.0.5.
The customer complains that from time to time the charger sends a message to the OCPP that the AC port is out of order
The customer sees the following message in the OCPP: "secc is out of order".
If you look at the log you will see that there is a problem and it has nothing to do with the fans issue.
So I kindly ask you to open the ticket again.
Thank you!
With best regards,

additional_info.body:

Problem Description:
Problem with
AC port after updating the charger from version 4.1.3 to version 7.0.5.
The customer complains that from time to time the charger sends a message to the OCPP that the AC port is out of order.
Action Performed (L2):
Log analysis done- (Internal error for Outlet 2)
Charger SW Version
: v7.0.
Reason for Handover (L3
): Deeper Analysis
Attachment
: Logs attached
In our initial analysis the error
'Fans_GQ2-3'
- was observed on SCB.
After discussed with RC
ievgen.tokhtamyshev@siemens.com
, -confirmed that
the problem with the fans has existed since the commissioning a year ago. We have checked everything many times. We have also replaced the fans. This does not help. Our specialists from DI believe that the problem is in the diagnostics principle.
Further we analyzed the Logs on AWS and observed this error multiple times from14/07 to 16/7
{"connectorId":2,"errorCode":"OtherError","status":"Faulted","vendorId":"SICHARGE D","vendorErrorCode":"secc is out of order"}
